card.title: 1st TAIPEI REGIMENT
card.text: Destruction: Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ.
card.flavorText: The 1st Taipei Regiment was a subordinate of the 48th Division of the Imperial Japanese Army, and its call sign was the Sea Division. The 48th Division was initially part of the Taiwan Army, but reassigned to the 14th Army in 1941 and mechanized in preparation for the Pacific War. The division was one of the first forces to land in the Philippines and captured Manila, but then reassigned to the 16th Army in eastern Java and ordered to capture Surabaya and its oil fields. The division was then assigned to garrison duty on the island of Timor as part of the 19th Army where it stayed until the Japanese surrender in 1945.
